text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On my day off, I pay a visit to the school
library.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... "The Five-Star Italian
Compendium" and "The Ultimate
Chinese
Culinary Challenge"? Hmm, these aren't
really what I had in
mind...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Oh! "Energizing Meals Made Easy"? That
sounds in the right ballpark.
Yeah, I think
I'll check out this one today—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, Teach?! Why're you here? Didja
come to stock up on stuff to
read like me?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Noticing a book in Hishi Amazon's hands, I
ask her what it's about.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, this? It's a cookbook. You can only
grow your repertoire so much
on your own,
y'know?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Sometimes I check out stuff like this to
really step up my culinary
game. 'Cause I
don't just read the recipes—I actually
make 'em.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
So c'mon, Teach! We're gonna go load up
on the ingredients listed in
this book!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
'Kay, grab a shopping cart, and I'll start
tossin' stuff in! First up is
pumpkin, then
fish sauce... Huh, I've never used that one
before.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
You bet! I do it every day! Then I give my
power-packed provisions to
the
youngsters. Feels good to see 'em scarf
them down.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
A hobby? Well, I guess you could call it
that. But it's not really about
the cooking
itself...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Actually, Teach, you seem really into this.
Does that mean you cook
too?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Huh?! So what you're saying is...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
You've been acting all casual, but you're
actually my rival! This whole
time, you
were just playing dumb!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Dammit! Then that means I just showed my
whole hand to the
competition! Argh!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Well, whatever. I'll lay all my cards down
on the table and still score a
crushing
victory! That's how ol' Hishiama gets stuff
done!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it obvious? The two of us are both
whizzes in the kitchen. So
there's only one
thing to do! Have a one-on-one!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
As fellow travelers down the path of
cuisine, we won't be satisfied 'til
we prove
who's best, right?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Aww, c'mon, have some guts. Finding out
that you cook too really lit a
fire under
me.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
It's good for us Umas and our trainers to
square off on the same field
once in a
while, don'tcha think? So let's have a
cook-off!

text_block_list.name: Referee Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
We have the entire cafeteria to ourselves,
so that means it's cook-off
time!

text_block_list.name: Referee Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
In one corner, we have our dorm
leader—the iron maiden of the
kitchen,
Hishiama! All of us can vouch for her
cooking skills.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Just so you know, I won't be holding back.

text_block_list.name: Referee Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
And in the other corner, we have
Hishiama's trainer. If you want to
win,
you'll have to serve up something that
seriously tickles my taste
buds! Ooh, I
can't wait! ♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hey, don't hijack our match just to stuff
yourself!

text_block_list.name: Referee Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, let my stomach get the better of
me for a minute there...

text_block_list.name: Referee Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, let's get back to it. In this battle
of teacher and student, it's
eat or be
eaten! Let the cook-off... begin!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Aw yeeeah! It's on, Teach! Take that, and
that! Gotta get that pot
simmering!
Bubble, bubble, bubble!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what's the problem? That's just the
way I get into it. Doesn't it
help heat
things up?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: You'd better get rolling too. Let's see what you can really do!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Following a fiery cooking session, we set
our dishes side by side on
the table.

text_block_list.name: Referee Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Now then, it's time to taste the
submissions. Here we have the
trainer's
dish—cheese and carrot gratin topped with
honey.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Whaaat?! You totally sold your soul, Teach! Look at you stuffing your dish with popular ingredients just to pander to the judge!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Curse you, junk food cook!
Tch, whatever.
Go on and taste it already.

text_block_list.name: Referee Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Yes, ma'am. Munch, munch... Mmm, yum! It's melting in my mouth! ♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... I'd better try a bite too... No,
scratch that! My pride won't
allow it.

text_block_list.name: Referee Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Next up is Hishiama's entry—lightly
simmered pumpkin and...
mincemeat?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
That's right! It's a brand-new recipe I
found in a book. I know it looks
plain, but
just try it.

text_block_list.name: Referee Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Yes, ma'am. Munch, munch... ...This flavor!

text_block_list.name: Referee Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
It's super plain! Not only does it look
plain, it tastes plain too!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you don't have to say it like that!
Argh... Guess it doesn't have
much impact
compared to Teach's junk food.

text_block_list.name: Referee Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Oh... But wait a minute. The flavor...

text_block_list.name: Referee Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
It's plain, but there's something else
there... Feels like I'm being
warmed up
from the inside...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, looks like you finally noticed! That's
my secret weapon.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
You should try it too, Teach. I'm sure it'll
strike a chord with you. Trust
me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Taking a spoonful of the stew, I feel the
delicate flavor spreading
through my
body.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On top of being delicious, her cooking is
thoughtfully prepared to
cater to those
who will eat it. But when I attempt to give
my
compliments to the chef...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Kn-knock it off! Did you forget I'm your
rival? I dunno how I'm
supposed to
respond to that.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: But yeah, that's what I was gettin' at earlier. You were right—my hobby is cooking. But that's not the whole story.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: My real hobby is cooking up healthy foods that'll give people energy and motivation. That goes for you too, Teach!

text_block_list.name: Referee Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Tweeeeet! The judges have reached their
decision. The winner of this
captivating
culinary contest is none other than...

text_block_list.name: Referee Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Actually, they were both delicious, so it's a
tie!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Huh?! What the heck?! You made it sound like I was a shoo-in for first place!

text_block_list.name: Referee Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
But that melted cheese was just sooo
good!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Grr, falling for such an obvious trick... Go
drown yourself in boba tea
or something!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, what do we do now, Teach? Our
big one-on-one ended in a
draw! How're
we supposed to solve this?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
A rematch? Oh, yeah! That's right! Even if
it ended in a tie this time
around, we can
just do it again. We'll have plenty of
chances from
here on out.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Haha. You're going down next time,
Teach! You and I are partners,
but when it
comes to the kitchen, we're rivals through
and through!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Delighted to have found a worthy
adversary in her hobby, Amazon
continues
to pursue gentle flavors in her cooking—in
stark contrast to
her personality.
